settings.question: What products do you offer?
settings.answer: Lumière Silk offers elegant silk scarves, gift-ready sets, and selected accessories designed with softness, refinement, and timeless beauty in mind.

settings.question: What material are your scarves made from?
settings.answer: All Lumière Silk scarves are crafted from 100% Mulberry Silk with a luxurious twill finish.

settings.question: Do your products come in gift packaging?
settings.answer: Some products include gift-ready packaging or gift box presentation. Please refer to the individual product description for details.

settings.question: Do you ship within Canada?
settings.answer:
Yes, Lumière Silk currently focuses mainly on shipping within Canada. We offer complimentary Canada-wide shipping on orders over CAD $75.

Most orders arrive within 2–5 business days.

settings.question: Do you ship to the United States?
settings.answer: At this stage, our primary focus is Canada. U.S. shipping may be added in the future.

settings.question: How long does shipping take?
settings.answer: Shipping times may vary depending on the destination and shipping method selected at checkout. A confirmation email with tracking information will be provided when available.

settings.question: Can I return or exchange an item?
settings.answer: Eligible items may be returned or exchanged within the stated return period, provided they are unused, in original condition, and returned with the original packaging.

settings.question: Are gift sets and accessories returnable?
settings.answer: For hygiene and product protection reasons, certain items such as earrings or selected gift sets may be final sale unless they arrive damaged or incorrect.

settings.question: How should I care for my scarf?
settings.answer: We recommend gentle handling, avoiding harsh chemicals, and following the care instructions provided on the product page.

settings.question: How can I contact you?
settings.answer: You may contact us through our Contact page or by email at hello@lumieresilk.ca.
